newsitem.title: GERMANY: Prodi rules out political EMU delay for Italy - RFTV.
newsitem.headline: Prodi rules out political EMU delay for Italy - RFTV.

text.p: Italian Prime Minister Romano Prodi on Friday ruled out any political agreement to delay Italy's entry into European monetary union (EMU).

"There is no possibility" of a political deal, Prodi told Reuters Financial Television after a press conference with German Chancellor Helmut Kohl. The two leaders did not discuss any kind of agreement to delay Italy's entry, Prodi said.
"Maybe the bureaucrats are discussing it. I'm not," he said. "If we join, we shall join with right and correct behavior. We should be a strength for the union, not a problem."

Prodi also said the meeting with Kohl lifted his confidence that Italy could meet the EMU requirements. "We both hope to be successful. Of course, probably I have more work to do (than Kohl), but I am confident, more confident than a few months or weeks ago."
